full_judgment: 2. The prayer for pre-emption was contested primarily on the ground that the Miscellaneous case filed under section 24 of the Non-Agricultural Tenancy Act was not maintainable since the land is not non-agricultural land and as such pre-emptor was required to file application for pre-emption under section 96 of the State Acquisition and Tenancy Act, 1950 (SAT Act). It was also contended that the transfer sought to be pre-empted took place by 2 deeds and that as the pre-emptor has not filed 2 separate cases for that two transactions, the prayer for pre-emption so sought in a single case is not maintainable.
